title: Actual-WOFOST Evolution and Temporal Semantics Readiness
purpose: Determine whether actual WOFOST evolution can be admitted on the current crop-owner lineage without importing legacy daily-driver assumptions into the kernel. This is a zero-production readiness unit. No crop evolution implementation is permitted unless committed phenology/climate-memory state, forcing/rate separation and temporal cadence are source-bound and transactionally admissible.

initial_route_scope.soybean_sw_wofost_2: separate future qualification because phenology equations differ
initial_route_scope.grass_sw_wofost_3: separate future qualification because management and temperature counters add state/cadence

daily_weather_or_derived_forcing: radiation inputs consumed by daily assimilation
accepted_interval_aggregates_from_other_: daily oxygen/root-aeration indicator IALPWET_DAY when that physics is active
nutrient stress only in a separately admitted nutrient execution class
forcing_rate_separation.rule: These are forcing/process results for an evolution window, not persistent crop state and not solver scratch.

temporal_policy.safe_initial_admission_candidate: explicit one-day crop-evolution event/window matching the B1.10 daily oracle, scheduled by runtime/event layer rather than assumed by the kernel
temporal_policy.future_generalization: only after scientific equivalence is demonstrated for interval splitting/aggregation, cohort creation/ageing, phenology thresholds and stress aggregation

transaction_requirements_after_unblock: the complete crop owner including phenology/climate-memory and biomass must be one F-KT physical state
assimilation/rate calculations must operate on trial-local inputs/results
rejected trials must not advance TSUM, DVS, vernalization, anthesis, running-temperature memory or leaf cohorts
replay from the same checkpoint with the same evolution-window forcing must be deterministic
potential shadow, if later enabled, must be separately transactional and optional
forbidden: replace legacy delt=1 by arbitrary dt and call it generic-time qualified
call daily WOFOST growth once per soil-water solver substep
store WOFOST_rates as persistent per-column state
make daynr/t1900/calendar values hidden kernel globals
advance actual crop state outside F-KT
silently allocate potential WOFOST shadow for every column
